title: Putting in for the Responsible Computer Science Challenge. Converting an old planetarium into a VR recording studio to make case studies about ethics
summary: Putting in for the Responsible Computer Science Challenge. Converting an old planetarium into a VR recording studio to make case studies about ethics in computer science. Trying to stay of social media until 1/22. Feel free to reach out here on my blog.
